description: Search Reddit posts. Each result comes with full post content and its top comments, so a single search usually answers the question without follow-up. Compact human-readable text by default; pass format='json' for full structured data. Use glim_reddit_get(ref) for a single post's complete comment tree. Page with cursor (response gives next_cursor when more exist). See docs://reddit-search.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

format.description: Output format. 'text' (default): compact human-readable view, fewer tokens. 'json': full structured data for machine parsing.

limit.description: Max posts (1-10), each with full content + top comments

sort.description: Sort order. Keep 'relevance' (default) for question or topic queries - it ranks by how well posts match your query. 'top'/'hot' rank by score/recency and largely ignore the query text, so use them only to browse what's popular in a subreddit.

start_date.description: Only posts on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: glim_reddit_search
title: Reddit Search
